name: Pay 2 life for a shockland that unlocks a hand card on turn 1-2
intent: On turn 1 or 2, once open-land-unlocks has had first refusal, play a shockland from hand and pay the 2 life when doing so makes some other hand card payable that is not payable now - Hallowed Fountain unlocking Otherworldly Gaze with nothing else up. A free untapped land always wins when one is available (this play's false repeats U's own key), and life stays unspent below 8: at 7 or less the 2 life is not worth a turn 1-2 card this early. Also stands down once a fetch in hand could reach a FREE BASIC unlock (unlocks_by_basic_search, not F's broader unlocks_by_search - a fetch that can only reach a non-basic unlock, a shockland the library holds but no basic, never makes this play stand down, since F itself would then pay the fetch's own life cost on top of the shock's; hand Strand+Watery Grave+Otherworldly Gaze with only a library Watery Grave reachable is exactly that case - this play still pays for the hand Grave). Prefers a shock carrying a Plains subtype over one that does not when a genuine tie needs breaking (Hallowed Fountain over Breeding Pool for Otherworldly Gaze - this deck casts no green card, so Breeding Pool's own Forest half is dead weight, unlike Hallowed Fountain's live Plains half), then falls back to any shock. Only turns 1-2, land drop available, mine, precombat main, empty stack. Stands down once the discard outlet (a creature with an own +1/+1-counter-put ability, Psychic Frog in this 60) is already on the battlefield: that fact is byte-identical to the seat-admitted bin-fatty-vs-permanent-exile play's own battlefield-outlet true key, and it can never hold on a genuine turn 1-2 board anyway - the outlet costs two mana and has to survive a turn cycle before that play reads it as safe to fire, so this key costs this play nothing here and only prevents the two plays overlapping later in the game.
